d: "Balance of Power" focuses on the intersection of politics and global business. On today's show, Rep. Greg Stanton, a Democrat from Arizona who serves on the House Foreign Affairs and China Select committees, says Nvidia’s board should testify as Congress investigates Jensen Huang and the company. Former Defense Secretary Mark Esper discusses the national security questions surrounding Nvidia and China, the Trump administration’s options in Iran and the widening war in Ukraine. California Attorney General Rob Bonta says his office will press ahead with its civil investigation of Nvidia,…
